title: Demonic Blacksmith Forging
description: A muscular demonic figure with green and red skin, flaming head, and large blue wings kneels while forging on a red anvil, holding a hammer and emitting red, green, and blue laser beams from his eyes. An open wooden door with purple light and smoky green-red clouds appears in the background, with scattered papers and coins on the ground.
